term: existing proper spacetime part as composition component
definition: ExistingProperPartsAreComponents o F ComponentOf w := ∀ x, o.ExistsAt w x → PartOfSpacetime F x → x ≠ F.whole → ComponentOf x F.whole. It concerns only existing proper parts of this selected whole at this selected world, reusing the same Being domain and component relation as Case.RemoteFromAll. No all-worlds or all-containers bridge is imposed.
note: Analyst framework proposition, attribution deferred. An ordinary proper constituent such as an arm/body illustrates a part-to-composition mapping; belonging to a set, occupying a region, or being present by power does not itself supply it. Its metaphysical application to spacetime proper parts is OPEN: the Frame relation is unconstrained and may encode broader inclusion than intrinsic matter/form or quantitative composition. No new transitivity, asymmetry, well-foundedness or causal property is assumed. The absent-bridge control witnesses the formal API gap, not entitlement to call an incompatible component sense metaphysically correct. See docs/showcase-naturalism.md §4. A historical attribution would require a passage endorsing this same-sense bridge for the spacetime whole at the stated existence/world scope; none is asserted.
